messages:
Carla: Noticed spike in duplicate traces from EU frontend -> APAC GPU path after retry storms this morning. Prometheus alerts for otel_exporter_queue_len started firing around 07:12 UTC. Any ideas?

Ben: Can you paste an example trace header and a sample of the span ids? Trying to see if trace id is preserved across retries.

Carla: Here's a header we captured from the loadbalancer logs:

```
traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01
tracestate: vendor=abc,t=123
```

Also a snippet from the runtime log where we re-emit request with preserved trace id:
`emit_request id=foo retry=1 trace_id=4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736`

Ed: Gateway sampling is set to 100% for POST /v1/generate in eu region for now. That plus our default TTL for trace context (1h) means retried attempts reuse the same trace id and you get two full trees. We should consider shorter TTL or a 'new_root_on_retry' policy at the gateway.

Dina: Duplicated trees are blowing up our trace ingestion and inflating cost/SLO noise. Quick PromQL to show unique trace ids per minute compared to spans:

```
sum by (job) (increase(otel_spans_received_total[5m]))
/ ignoring(job) group_left() sum by (job) (increase(otel_traces_received_total[5m]))
```

We're seeing ~1.8x spans per unique trace during the spike.

Ben: From SDK side we can add an opt-in flag `preserveTraceOnRetry` (default=false) so retries create a child or new root instead of reusing top-level id. Example JS opt:

```
new TracerProvider({
  retryBehavior: { preserveTraceOnRetry: false }
})
```

Carla: That sounds good. Concern: some integrations expect preserved trace id for end-to-end correlation. Need a compatibility plan. Can we gate this behind gateway rewrite so apps don't need to change immediately?

Ed: Yes - gateway can rewrite headers on retry with a new traceparent and add `tracestate: rw=1` so we can detect rewritten flows. We'll add a canary rule for eu-prod->apac-gpu route.

Dina: Also propose changing alerting: lower sensitivity of 'high-cardinality-tag' alerts and add a deduped-trace rate panel to SLO dashboard so SREs see real error rates. We'll run a 24h backfill to estimate cost reduction.

Carla: Action items: Ben -> prototype SDK flag + unit tests. Ed -> gateway PR to add retry rewrite + sampling rule. Dina -> update Grafana panels and alert thresholds, run 24h backfill. I'll follow up on rollout timeline.

trace-bot: Created ticket INF-4523 for gateway canary and INF-4524 for SDK experiment :white_check_mark:

Carla: thanks all :thumbsup:
